_notes: Every world's height map as UQM 0.8.0's own GeneratePlanetSurface (plangen.c, gentopo.c) makes it on entering orbit from a new game, taken just before it is coloured. Code only, no content.

worlds: [star, planet, moon or -1, orbit entered, defined (Earth, whose surface is an image), SHA-256 of the MAP_WIDTH x MAP_HEIGHT signed bytes, row by row, or null, SHA-256 of the light map GenerateLightMap makes of it (all zeros for a gas giant) or null].
full: the whole height map of a few worlds, in hex.
